description: A Linux box with nothing installed. The control: the suite must be able to say no.
why: A suite that only asserts must_find cannot tell a working matcher from one that claims everything, and on Linux the lookalikes arrive for free: a stock Ubuntu ships libxcursor1 and libwayland-cursor0, whose names contain `cursor`. This is where an over-broad Linux route fails. `deb+rpm >= 1` because a Linux box always has packages -- a zero there would mean the branch did not run rather than that the machine is clean -- and which kind carries them is the distro's choice, so the floor sums the two. `scan >= 1` for the systemd marker, which is emitted on every run precisely so an unreadable unit list cannot look like a clean one.
known_gaps: Runs on whatever base image the job uses, so it proves nothing about a loaded desktop. 00-baseline has the same limitation on macOS.
